content.short: OneSafe is a neobank for global businesses that combines fiat banking with stablecoin settlement.
content.description: OneSafe provides digital-first business banking for global companies, bringing fiat accounts and crypto together with stablecoin settlement, with banking services delivered through partners. Stable's official ecosystem page lists OneSafe.
